name: v0.3.41 — receipt scan animation + floating Add menu (mobile)
releaseNotes:
• Receipts: a full-screen scan animation now plays while a photographed OR dictated receipt is being read — the Guac mascot with a sweeping magnifier, a scan-line tracking down a paper receipt, and a rotating status ticker (Looking for the store… → Saving to your Stash 🥑). Replaces the plain spinner.
• Receipts: the capture options are collapsed behind a single floating “+ Add” button — Take a photo / Pick from gallery / Voice — instead of separate app-bar icons.
• Data continues to sync live from getguac.app.
